To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the EMIT of the molecular signal from the Lotus or from the Retinoic Acid could be stored and replayed on the water system of the cell medium and that the EMIT procedure could induce a statistically significant decrease on the cell viability and the changes on the cell morphology.
the Lotus and Retinoic Acid signals can be transferred to the aqueous system and then to human neuroblastoma cell line.
Lotus and Retinoic acid can be transferred to cells via EMIT through water.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the possibility of transferring the information of biologically active molecules to cells through an electromagnetic carrier.
the development of a method of EMIT of specific molecular signals on target human neuroblastoma cell.
the study of the EMIT of molecular signals in aqueous system and their effect on target cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the present experimental evidence supports the concept of EMIT of molecular signals from chemical effector molecules to target cells mediated through the aqueous system.
the EMIT procedure could be considered an innovative approach to the transfer of molecular information through the electromagnetic system of the water molecules.

the EMIT phenomenon is a real biologic event and the results obtained in this work are consistent with the hypothesis that the electromagnetic field could transfer molecular information through an aqueous system and that the information could be recorded and transferred to a target cell.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the EMIT procedure is a physical process that could transfer information from the source molecule to water and to the target cell.

EMIT of chemical signals could be recorded and replayed by the aqueous cell culture medium and that this procedure may be a useful tool for the study of the molecular mechanisms of the biological activity of the source molecules.
water can be tuned in a manner that is related to the chemical structures of the source molecule.
The main takeaway from our work is that

EMIT of molecular signals from a source molecule to target cells can be transferred through the water system and this could have important implications in the understanding of the mechanisms of action of biologic active molecules.
the EMIT of molecular signals could be transferred from the original source to the target cell through a water system.
the electromagnetic information transfer of molecular signal from a source chemical effector to a target cell could be recorded and replayed by water.
